title: DEMO Fact Model (CIM)
description: Strict JSON Schema for the DEMO Computation Independent Model (Fact Model). Models Entity Types, Value Types, Attribute Types, Event Types, Generalizations, Aggregations, and Property Types according to the DEMO methodology.

entityTypes.description: All declared and derived entity types

name.description: Unique name of the entity type

derivationRule.description: OCL expression or description of the derivation rule (required when kind=derived, A9)

attributes.description: Attribute types of the entity type (A5)

events.description: Event types of the entity type (A6)

AttributeType.title: AttributeType
AttributeType.description: Attribute of an entity type, references a value type (A5)

valueType.description: Reference to the name of a ValueType

EventType.title: EventType
EventType.description: Event type of an entity type (A6). Maps to a Boolean attribute plus state machine states.

ValueType.title: ValueType
ValueType.description: Value type: categorical (A1) with literals, or non-categorical (A2) as a user-defined data type

kind.description: 'categorical' (A1) maps to Enumeration; 'non-categorical' (A2) maps to a user-defined DataType

Generalization.title: Generalization
Generalization.description: Generalization between two entity types (A10). The parent becomes abstract; the child inherits from the parent.

parent.description: Name of the general (abstract) entity type

child.description: Name of the specialized entity type

specializationKind.description: Kind of specialization: via event type (A7) or derivation rule (A9)

eventType.description: Name of the associated event type (only when specializationKind=eventType, A7)

propertyType.description: Name of the property type (only for A8: specialization of value type with event type)

Aggregation.title: Aggregation
Aggregation.description: Aggregation relationship between a whole entity type and a part entity type (A11)

whole.description: Name of the whole entity type

part.description: Name of the part entity type

PropertyType.title: PropertyType
PropertyType.description: Association / property type between entity types with cardinalities (A12)

source.description: Name of the source entity type

target.description: Name of the target entity type

lowerCardinality.description: Lower cardinality (0 or a positive integer)

upperCardinality.description: Upper cardinality (positive integer or '*' for unlimited)
